title: USTR Finalizes 25% Section 301 Tariff on Brazil, Effective July 22
detail: The Office of the US Trade Representative finalized a Notice of Action on July 15, 2026 imposing an additional 25% Section 301 tariff on a broad range of Brazilian-origin goods, effective for goods entered for consumption on or after July 22, 2026. The action followed a Section 301 investigation opened in July 2025 into Brazilian trade practices including digital-trade and electronic-payment restrictions, preferential tariffs, weak anti-corruption enforcement, IP protection gaps, ethanol market access, and illegal deforestation. Major exemptions include oil and gas, beef, coffee, oranges, and goods already in transit before July 22 (if entered by July 29). Secretary of State Marco Rubio accused Brazilian President Lula of negotiating in bad faith.
